item.title: How Did Everyone Miss The Signs At Fox Hollow Farm?
item.description: For years, Herbert Baumeister appeared to be a successful businessman and family man while men were disappearing across Indiana. Even after a human skull was discovered on his property and investigators began connecting him to missing men, they struggled to search the farm. In 1996, thousands of human bones were finally uncovered there, but Baumeister died by suicide before he could ever face trial.
